messages:
maya: heads-up: starting onboarding for llamaX-13B variant. weights uploaded to gs://redwood-models/llamaX/13B/v1/ — tokenizer seems to differ from our usual one. anyone seen sentinel/BOS/EOS behavior shift with this model?
samir: i pulled the weights earlier. tokenizer.json shows special_tokens: ['<s>', '</s>', '<|sentinel|>'] but the model's chat template in their repo references <|start|>. mismatch?
jing: that could be a naming mismatch. our mapping expects '<s>' as bos. if upstream used '<|start|>' as a single token, we might get off-by-one for prompt lengths and kv positions.
olivia: can you paste the tokenizer header and which chat template you're testing with?
maya: quick snippet: ```json {"special_tokens": {"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "sentinel_token": "<|sentinel|>"}, "added_tokens": []} ``` i'm testing with chatfmt v2 (system + user + assistant) — we insert a single BOS before system.
ramon: in chatfmt v2 we rely on a single BOS token `<s>` inserted before system. if the model expects a different sentinel or expects it placed after system, generation will eat the sentinel and shorten the usable prompt. explains token delta.
samir: i'll run a tokenizer diff locally. if `<|sentinel|>` tokenizes into multiple ids on our bpe, that'll cause prompt mismatch. running and will paste a small repro.
deploy-bot: deploy check: model-config.yaml lint OK, but tokenizer checksum mismatches catalog entry — error 409.
samir: diff result: our BPE splits `<|sentinel|>` into 3 tokens ['<','|','sentinel|>'] (i.e. not a single token). upstream expects it as single token — solution: add it to added_tokens so it's treated as one id.
jing: if we add it to added_tokens we must also pin vocab mapping in model catalog so serving runtime uses same vocab -> update catalog entry + checksum. we should also rebuild tokenizer assets and include a tiny test.
olivia: can we do a runtime fallback that rewrites `<|sentinel|>` -> `<s>` at request ingress? feels like a fragile bandaid for quality-sensitive prompts.
maya: plan proposal: samir to create a tokenizer patch (add token to added_tokens + mapping file) → PR to model-assets → i'll validate prompt lengths and run a smoke-gen. if green, we update catalog and bump checksum. objections?
ramon: :thumbsup: no objections. also add a regression test in tokenization tests to prevent recurrence.
samir: PR posted: https://git.redwood/mdl/llamaX-13b-token-fix/pull/12 — includes token.json + small unit test. CI running.
maya: thanks. one more note: watch kv-cache warmup offsets — if BOS id changes, cached positions shift and latency/throughput profiles in Dedicated can vary. we'll do a perf smoke on dedicated after rollout.
jing: i'll add a non-blocking startup assert in serving that checks bos_token id matches catalog entry and emits a warning if mismatch.
maya: perfect. i'll update the onboarding checklist with explicit steps: 1) verify sentinel identity, 2) tokenizer checksum match, 3) prompt-length smoke, 4) kv-cache perf smoke. i'll post the checklist update to the eng-ml onboarding doc and close thread when CI + smoke pass.
